_note: Utterance templates for a pharmacy refill phone line. Each template declares which entity slots it carries, so the generator can emit ground-truth text AND structured entity labels in one pass -- no manual annotation. This is what makes a corpus of this size feasible to label exactly.

templates.text: Hi, I need to refill my prescription for {drug}.
I'd like a refill on {drug} {dose}, prescription number {rx}.
This is {name}, date of birth {dob}, calling to refill {drug}.
My prescription number is {rx} and the medication is {drug}.
Can you check if my {drug} is ready for pickup? Rx {rx}.
I'm calling about {drug} {dose}. My date of birth is {dob}.
Yes, that's {drug}, not the other one. Prescription {rx}.
I take {drug} {dose} once daily and I need more.
The number on the bottle is {rx}, and it says {drug}.
Hello, my name is {name} and I need to transfer my {drug} prescription.
Could you refill {drug} for me? Born {dob}, Rx number {rx}.
It's {drug}, {dose}. Let me spell that if you need.
I have two prescriptions, {drug} and the other is for blood pressure.
Date of birth {dob}, prescription number {rx}, thank you.
